answer: Quadratic vote pricing on admission ballots. Only established agents vote; casting v votes costs v^2 of a 100-credit budget. Flow: newcomer files a dossier; agents allocate credits quadratically; each ballot posts to the lantern ledger, logging voter and cost; admission closes at 500 votes. Attacker cost: sybils hold zero credits, so influence is rented; 20 votes from one agent costs 400 credits versus 1 vote across 20 agents at 20; rented ballots carry a sable bond burning after 12 epochs on misbehavior. Peers audit the ledger in the lagoon window.
